basic_profile.bio: Avid gamer and Minecraft enthusiast, discovering the world of modded gaming. Originally from Denver, Colorado, I enjoy spending my free time exploring new game mods and engaging in online discussions about gaming strategies. Currently working as a graphic designer, I often find myself online during evenings and weekends. I'm single and enjoy connecting with fellow gamers around the world.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: Primarily self-taught in gaming and modding through online forums and YouTube tutorials. Recently started experimenting with mod packs, especially those related to Minecraft. Learning through trial and error and community feedback.
